name: Kale Salad with Soft-Boiled Eggs, Squash, Goat Cheese & Walnuts
instructions: Wash, dry, trim, and peel squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out the seeds, and medium dice the flesh. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Drizzle squash with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Toss to coat and spread out in an even layer.

Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until squash is golden and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and let cool, 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place eggs in a medium saucepan, cover with water, and bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 4 minutes. Drain hot water and add ice or run under cold water to cool.
While the eggs are cooking, place oil, vinegar, Dijon, honey, salt, and pepper in a large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
Peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the dressing and stir to combine.
Wash and dry kale. Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems. Finely chop leaves and add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Roughly chop walnuts and add to the bowl.
Crumble goat cheese into the bowl.
Once the squash is cool, add to the bowl and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with eggs. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
